title: Register with RetireReady NJ or certify a retirement plan exemption
authority: RetireReady NJ (NJ Secure Choice Savings Board)
description: Employers above the program's size threshold with no qualified plan must register or certify an exemption. The threshold was 25 employees (deadline for 25 to 39 employees August 15, 2025); one 2026 source says it dropped to 10 with an April 1 deadline, so check the program. Penalties: a warning in year one, rising to $500 per employee by year five.

appliesWhen.description: 25 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)
